verdict.rationale: Kong's Vault entity supports storing secrets via environment variables and Konnect can manage multiple control-planes/data-planes (dev/staging/prod) with decK enabling APIOps promotion across environments, which loosely supports environment-based configuration. However there is no explicit feature described for a developer to 'switch requests' between named environment variable sets the way a client tool would. Missing for 10: explicit environment-switching UI/CLI feature, named environment profiles (dev/staging/prod) tied to variable sets, and any hands-on or independent confirmation of this workflow.
